# Managed by Ansible: centralized inventory log collector
module(load="imudp")
module(load="imtcp")

input(type="imudp" port="514" ruleset="remoteInventory")
input(type="imtcp" port="514" ruleset="remoteInventory")

ruleset(name="remoteInventory") {
    if $fromhost-ip == '{{ app_node_ip }}' and $programname == 'inventory' then {
        action(type="omfile" file="/var/log/inventory/node2.log")
    }
    stop
}
---
# Managed by Ansible: forward inventory application logs to centralized collector
if $programname == 'inventory' then {
    action(
        type="omfwd"
        target="{{ collector_node_ip }}"
        port="514"
        protocol="tcp"
        queue.type="LinkedList"
        queue.filename="inventory_fwd"
        queue.maxdiskspace="104857600"
        queue.saveOnShutdown="on"
        action.resumeRetryCount="-1"
        action.resumeInterval="10"
    )
}
